notes.title: Improvements
notes.content: [p][b]Patch Note[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added random jumpscares to increase game tension.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented statue highlights to improve interaction and visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes and general optimizations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[p][b]Hotfix Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented players from taking photos.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted map lighting to improve overall visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Monster updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vision arc increased to [b]270°[/b] with a [b]50-unit[/b] detection range.[/p][/*][*][p]Base speed increased by [b]20%[/b] ([i]1.2×[/i]) from the start of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new mechanic: taking a photo of a monster will make it disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes and optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p]A special thanks goes to [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/missj3rik0"][/dynamiclink] and their entire community.
They helped us identify issues and significantly improve the game by providing constructive, actionable feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content: [p]We've identified some gameplay issues and a few critical bugs:[/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A crash related to encounters with brain rots[/p][/*][*][p]Persistent glitch sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The flashlight now illuminates surrounding areas more effectively[/p][/*][*][p]Monster sounds can now only be heard at close range[/p][/*][*][p]Increased overall smoothness and responsiveness[/p][/*][/list]
